token_set.name: Hometown History: Detroit Red Wings
token_set.description: Introducing Hometown History: Detroit Red Wings, a compilation of highlights commemorating historical moments celebrated by the Red Wings during the 2024-25 season. These collectibles not only honor the rich history of the team but also rewind the clock to capture the players and achievements that solidify the franchise in the hearts of fans, and within the pages of NHL history.

description:
After splitting the first two games of the Stanley Cup Final at home, the Detroit Red Wings traveled to Carolina for a pivotal Game 3. With the score tied at two apiece, the game stretched into a grueling third overtime, where Igor Larionov etched his name in playoff history. Starting in the defensive zone, Larionov chipped the puck off the boards and down the ice, where Tomas Holmstrom chased it down. Reaching the puck first, Holmstrom collected it just inside the offensive blue line and passed it back to Larionov, who was following the play. Demonstrating exceptional composure, Larionov dodged a sliding defender and outwaited the goalie before firing a backhander into the net. The overtime winner was Larionov's second goal of the night. Detroit subsequently won the next two games to secure the Stanley Cup, marking Larionov's third championship, all won with the Red Wings, contributing to his storied Hockey Hall of Fame career.
